strings.d1.theme: Marina Bay and Gardens by the Bay
strings.d1.s0.name: Gardens by the Bay Cloud Forest
strings.d1.s0.tips: Cloud Forest + Flower Dome combo ticket (~46 SGD). Go in at the 09:00 opening: an indoor waterfall and cool air.
strings.d1.s1.name: Supertree Grove
strings.d1.s1.tips: Giant metal trees; the OCBC Skyway (14 SGD) is optional.
strings.d1.s2.name: Satay by the Bay
strings.d1.s2.tips: The gardens' hawker centre: satay and chilli crab with bay views.
strings.d1.s3.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
strings.d1.s3.tips: Observation deck on the 57th floor; book a sunset slot. The pool is for hotel guests only.
strings.d1.s4.name: Spectra Light Show
strings.d1.s4.tips: Free water and light show in front of Marina Bay Sands at 20:00 and 21:00. The Supertree Garden Rhapsody also runs at 19:45 and 20:45.
strings.d1.b0.name: Lau Pa Sat
strings.d1.b0.tips: Victorian-era hawker centre; Satay Street sets up in the evening.
strings.d1.b1.name: ArtScience Museum
strings.d1.b1.tips: Lotus-shaped museum with the Future World exhibition; a good rainy-day option.
strings.d2.s0.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
strings.d2.s0.tips: Tang-style temple with a rooftop garden and prayer wheel; free entry.
strings.d2.s1.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
strings.d2.s1.tips: Immigrant life inside a shophouse; small but moving.
strings.d2.s2.name: Maxwell Food Centre
strings.d2.s2.tips: Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice: join the queue at 11:30, 5 SGD.
strings.d2.s3.name: Ann Siang Hill
strings.d2.s3.tips: Restored shophouses and cafes; Club Street is nearby.
strings.d2.s4.name: Tiong Bahru
strings.d2.s4.tips: Art deco housing blocks; try croissants at Tiong Bahru Bakery and browse the bookshop BooksActually.
strings.d2.b0.name: Tiong Bahru Market
strings.d2.b0.tips: Local hawker centre; try chwee kueh (steamed rice cakes) and lor mee (noodles in thick gravy).
strings.d2.b1.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
strings.d2.b1.tips: The oldest Hindu temple in Singapore, in Chinatown.
strings.d3.s0.name: Universal Studios Singapore
strings.d3.s0.tips: Full-day theme park (~83 SGD). Arrive at opening for Transformers and Battlestar Galactica; an express pass is worth it in the crowds.
strings.d3.s1.name: Malaysian Food Street RWS
strings.d3.s1.tips: Hawker food on Sentosa; you can leave the park to eat here.
strings.d3.s2.name: Sentosa Skyline Luge
strings.d3.s2.tips: Downhill luge ride; go at sunset.
strings.d3.s3.name: Wings of Time
strings.d3.s3.tips: Water and light show on Siloso Beach; take the 19:40 show.
strings.d3.b0.name: Coastes Siloso
strings.d3.b1.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
strings.d3.b1.tips: Giant aquarium; calmer than Universal Studios.
strings.d4.s0.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
strings.d4.s0.tips: Colourful Hindu temple on Serangoon Road; morning prayers.
strings.d4.s1.name: Tekka Centre
strings.d4.s1.tips: Little India's market and hawker centre; have roti prata (flaky flatbread) and teh tarik (pulled milk tea) for breakfast.
strings.d4.s2.name: Mustafa Centre
strings.d4.s2.tips: Huge department store open 24 hours; it sells everything.
strings.d4.s3.name: Sultan Mosque
strings.d4.s3.tips: Kampong Glam's golden-domed mosque; outside visiting hours, admire it from the outside.
strings.d4.s4.name: Haji Lane
strings.d4.s4.tips: Narrow graffiti-covered lane with boutiques and cafes; the Arab Street fabric shops are close by.
strings.d4.b0.name: Zam Zam Restaurant
strings.d4.b0.tips: Serving murtabak (stuffed pan-fried bread) since 1908; opposite the Sultan Mosque.
strings.d4.b1.name: Malay Heritage Centre
strings.d4.b1.tips: Former palace with Malay history exhibits.
strings.d5.s0.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
strings.d5.s0.tips: UNESCO-listed gardens; the Orchid Garden costs 15 SGD. Mornings are cooler.
strings.d5.s1.name: Henderson Waves
strings.d5.s1.tips: The undulating wooden bridge of the Southern Ridges; a forest-canopy walk to Mount Faber.
strings.d5.s2.name: Mount Faber Peak
strings.d5.s2.tips: Views over the harbour and Sentosa from the hilltop; the cable car station is here.
strings.d5.s3.name: VivoCity Food Republic
strings.d5.s3.tips: Food court floor of the HarbourFront mall; air-conditioned.
strings.d5.s4.name: Labrador Nature Reserve
strings.d5.s4.tips: Coastal nature park with war relics and mangroves.
strings.d5.b0.name: Casa Verde Botanic Gardens
strings.d5.b1.name: MacRitchie TreeTop Walk
strings.d5.b1.tips: Suspension bridge forest walk (3 hours); an alternative to the Southern Ridges.
strings.d6.s0.name: Changi Point Ferry Terminal
strings.d6.s0.tips: The bumboat leaves once it has 12 passengers; 4 SGD, 10 minutes.
strings.d6.s1.name: Pulau Ubin Village Bicycle Rental
strings.d6.s1.tips: Bikes at the island entrance cost 10 SGD per day; Singapore's village of the 1960s.
strings.d6.s2.name: Chek Jawa Wetlands
strings.d6.s2.tips: Mangrove boardwalk and tidal flats; look out for wild boar and monkeys.
strings.d6.s3.name: Pulau Ubin Seafood Restaurant
strings.d6.s3.tips: Seafood at the village jetty; simple.
strings.d6.s4.name: Changi Village Hawker Centre
strings.d6.s4.tips: Nasi lemak (coconut rice) on the way back, in Changi Village.
strings.d6.b0.name: Puaka Hill Pulau Ubin
strings.d6.b0.tips: The island's hilltop, with views over the quarry lake.
strings.d6.b1.name: Cheong Lian Yuen Restaurant Pulau Ubin
strings.d6.b1.tips: Seafood in the island village; a fallback if the other restaurant is full.
strings.d7.s0.name: National Gallery Singapore
strings.d7.s0.tips: Southeast Asian art in the former City Hall and Supreme Court buildings; rooftop terrace.
strings.d7.s1.name: Boat Quay
strings.d7.s1.tips: Riverside shophouses; walk on to the Merlion.
strings.d7.s2.name: Merlion Park
strings.d7.s2.tips: The lion-fish statue; a farewell photo with views of Marina Bay.
strings.d7.s3.name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Clarke Quay
strings.d7.s3.tips: Peppery pork rib soup; a farewell lunch.
strings.d7.s4.name: Changi Airport Jewel
strings.d7.s4.tips: The world's tallest indoor waterfall; a mall to explore before your flight.
strings.d7.b0.name: Amoy Street Food Centre
strings.d7.b0.tips: Hawker centre in the CBD; an alternative to bak kut teh.
strings.d7.b1.name: Asian Civilisations Museum
strings.d7.b1.tips: Riverside museum; an alternative to the gallery.
strings.note0: Use a contactless card on the MRT. The city is small, and a taxi (Grab) costs 10-20 SGD. The MRT to Changi takes 45 minutes.
strings.note1: Return your tray at hawker centres (there is a fine). Reserving a table with a tissue packet ('chope') is a local custom. A meal costs 5-8 SGD.
strings.note2: November to January is monsoon season: daily downpours, so carry an umbrella. Temperatures stay around 30°C all year.
strings.note3: Chewing gum is banned, and littering and smoking are fined. Supermarkets do not sell alcohol after 22:30.
strings.note4: USS and Cloud Forest tickets are cheaper online. Some museums close on Mondays.
strings.note5: No tipping: a 10% service charge and 9% GST are added.
strings.transit.name: EZ-Link / contactless card
strings.transit.why_chosen: Works on the MRT and buses; a contactless bank card does the same job
